analysis:
Examined all supplied workflow excerpts, base/head comparisons, patches, documentation and file metadata. The changes introduce CI Git-cache reuse, conditional cache writes, sparse checkout and a mimo_audio classifier output; no concrete security regression is established in this scope. In ci.yml:665-706 and the repeated cluster steps, restored Git metadata receives connectivity checks, checkout disables credential persistence, and writes require SAVE_CACHES. Connectivity checks are not authentication of cached configuration; however, no attacker-controlled cache writer is established. The supplied workflow patch defines SAVE_CACHES as master/dev pushes only. Actions are revision-pinned. ci.yml:913-970 changes cluster build identity and cache persistence; coverage reporting and test gate behavior at 537-653 and 1170-1202 are unchanged according to the range map.
component-changes.yml:12-13,28 forwards mimo_audio without adding privileges. docs-impact.yml:61-68 excludes archive/media working-tree contents but retains full commit history and leaves signature verification unchanged. No changes to prompt encryption, serving authorization, billing, runtime KV-cache isolation (T-041), local holds or privileged helpers are visible. CI artifact integrity is relevant to A-011/A-017 and T-013/T-054, but these excerpts do not show release qualification consuming these caches.
Integration should verify scripts/ci-component-paths.py emits mimo_audio for every gate input; reconcile its consuming gate with the changelog claim at line 8. Verify provider-ci-build/action.yml honors save-caches, provider-release-cache.py correctly invalidates changed sources (ci.yml:934-942), and the build-cache identity prevents stale products. Reconcile docs/developer/build.md:170-174,273-277,299-384 with the installer and routing implementations, especially tool-cache provenance and admitted push branches. These are unverified PR contracts, not findings; source from those changed components is needed for the next pass.
